goal: VC-201-099 (P1) claims mastery of: Expose actual workload, resource, provider, configuration, federation, and evidence state through consistent CLI/API views; drill-down explains blocked work and actions obey the same grants and preconditions as automation.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: the operator surface renders providers, GPU and the queue (idle and no-GPU cases included), and susi fix applies the safe doctor findings. Verified by `tests/tui_top.rs` (tui_top_renders_providers_gpu_and_queue, tui_top_idle_queue_and_no_gpu) and `tests/zc_susi_fix.rs` (zc_susi_fix_applies_safe_doctor_findings). Residual: consistent CLI/API views across workload, resource, provider, confi. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_099_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record. Do not reserve .agents/roadmap-verdicts in your claim: the directory is exempt from the scope check precisely so a verdict commits under your source claim, and reserving it would overlap every other verification task and serialize them all. Reserve the source paths you will touch, and add a scope if the verdict needs to change the vector's narrative in .agents/roadmap.json. Evidence must name something real: a path that exists in the checkout, or an identifier (a test name) that appears in it. The checker verifies this, so a verdict cannot be closed by typing a claim.
title: Verify mastery: Provide a unified operator control surface
